extracted.intended_audience: readers and prospective mail subscribers of the 1909 pulp weekly 'Motor Stories' (general public/pulp magazine customers)
extracted.subtask_description: Subscription and ordering terms for the pulp weekly 'Motor Stories' including pricing, permitted payment methods, receipt policy, and publisher contact information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Subscription and single-copy rates
rubrics_metrics.description: Lists prices for single copies/back numbers and various subscription durations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Verbatim rates given: "Single Copies or Back Numbers, 5c. Each." Then: "3 months 65c. 4 months 85c. 6 months $1.25 One year 2.50 2 copies one year 4.00 1 copy two years 4.00". Header: "TERMS TO MOTOR STORIES MAIL SUBSCRIBERS. (Postage Free.)"

rubrics_metrics.name: How to send money (acceptable payment methods and risk allocation)
rubrics_metrics.description: Specifies acceptable methods for sending payment and who bears risk for different methods.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Verbatim guidance: "=How to Send Money=--By post-office or express money-order, registered letter, bank check or draft, at our risk. At your own risk if sent by currency, coin, or postage-stamps in ordinary letter." This indicates preferred secure methods (money-order, registered letter, check/draft) are sent at publisher's risk; loose currency/coins/postage-stamps in ordinary letter are sent at sender's risk.

rubrics_metrics.name: Receipt / credit acknowledgement policy
rubrics_metrics.description: Explains how the publisher acknowledges payments and what the subscriber should do if not credited correctly.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Verbatim guidance: "=Receipts=--Receipt of your remittance is acknowledged by proper change of number on your label. If not correct you have not been properly credited, and should let us know at once."

rubrics_metrics.name: Where / to whom payments and correspondence should be sent (publisher contact)
rubrics_metrics.description: Gives proprietors and publisher name and postal address for remittance and correspondence.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Verbatim listing: "ORMOND G. SMITH, GEORGE C. SMITH, Proprietors. STREET & SMITH, Publishers, 79-89 Seventh Avenue, New York City." Implied requirement: send remittances/correspondence to the publisher at that address.
